question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**equipment**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes augmented reality (AR) applications providing troubleshooting information when a user points their device at malfunctioning items.
 
• The term should refer to a device or item that can malfunction in an industrial setting, which makes "equipment" the most suitable option.
 
• "Equipment" refers to machinery or tools, which fits the context of AR apps used for industrial troubleshooting.
 
• Other options ("arsenal", "outfit", "baggage") do not align with the context of industrial technology or troubleshooting tasks.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Arsenal" refers to a collection of weapons or resources, which does not apply to the context of malfunctioning machinery.
 
• **Option 3: **"Outfit" refers to clothing, which is not relevant to the context of industrial tools or machines.
 
• **Option 4: **"Baggage" refers to luggage, which is not related to the industrial context mentioned in the passage.
